about.en: KUB Coin is the native coin of KUB Chain (formerly Bitkub Chain), an EVM blockchain developed by Bitkub Blockchain Technology Co., Ltd., part of Thailand's Bitkub Capital Group. KUB pays gas fees on KUB Chain, is staked by validators and delegators, and can be converted to fee credits on the Bitkub exchange. An ERC-20 representation, "Bitkub Token", exists on Ethereum at 0x0649Cef6D11ed6F88535462E147304d3FE5ae14D.
